relief_gap.interpretation: Under-65 cost-burdened owners (868 households) have no path through Marblehead's current statutory relief programs, which are all 65+ (with the exception of veteran-status / blind / surviving-spouse clauses). For seniors, the gap depends on how many of the 144 FY24 exemptions went to cost-burdened recipients vs. lower-burden seniors who happen to meet income criteria. Without per-clause data, the most defensible read is that no more than 144 of 804 senior cost-burdened owners receive any statutory relief. Circuit Breaker (state income tax credit) is potentially available to seniors but uptake is not tracked at the municipal level in available data.

sources: ACS B25106 (Tenure by Housing Costs as % of Household Income), 2023 5-year vintage, Marblehead town
ACS B25093 (Age of Householder by SMOCAPI), 2023 5-year vintage, Marblehead town
